reviews.text: The lady that does travel docs is bit slow. Doesn’t know the difference between exact and estimate.

This is the best clinic hands down. I came to the Little Tokyo Vet Clinic to get help with a pet health certificate for international travel. The team was very responsive and always hands-on with my case. The USDA was having delays with paperwork but the team at this clinic did everything to help me and my dog get to our destination. The price paid here is definitely worth it, especially since I get one-on-one care and can contact the team at anytime. You are paying for best kind of care. I have gone to “cheaper” vets outside of LA County and the service has always been “in and out”, nonchalant, and bad service. Here that is NEVER the problem. The doctors here are very thorough with the examinations and always give you a price breakdown before proceeding with any treatment. I can’t emphasize enough how emphatic, helpful, and brilliant this team is. I would have been pulling my hair out during my move to a new country without their help.

Some other perks:
Parking is FREE and secured
Free refreshments
Clinic is safe and secure with locked doors
Staff always present
Texting option available for communication
Multi-lingual staff and doctors
Great location at the heart of Little Tokyo

For as long as I am in Los Angeles, I will be going here. Can’t wait to come back to the states and bring my dog!

Trying to book an apt because I did a walk in here once and had an amazing experience with the vet…. Not so much with whoever I was speaking to to book a new appointment. Reading the conversation back I’m not even sure how someone could view that as professional. Very disappointed it’s hard to find good vets in DTLA and I truly liked the people here the first time.
Little Tokyo is no longer safe.

I recently moved back into the area, and today my dog experienced a very serious medical emergency. He could barely walk, was breathing heavily, foaming at the mouth, shivering, and vomiting repeatedly. I immediately brought him to this veterinary clinic despite knowing that it is quite expensive, because this was a serious emergency and the clinic is only about 500 feet from where we live.

When I arrived, I was greeted at the reception desk by a young woman who appeared extremely nonchalant and seemed bothered to even acknowledge me. I explained that I believed my dog may have ingested something toxic and that I needed him to be examined. I also explained all of his symptoms, which were clearly visible to her.

Without even looking up at my dog, her response was, “Hmm, this seems like a medical emergency, but you would need to come back tomorrow afternoon because we can’t see him right now.”

I was completely taken aback. How was I supposed to come back tomorrow afternoon when my dog was clearly in distress and potentially fighting for his life right in front of her?

I then asked if she could provide me with the contact information for an emergency veterinary clinic. She responded just as nonchalantly, saying that she would text it to me. I could not believe the lack of urgency or compassion shown throughout the entire interaction.

I left immediately and rushed my dog to Modern Animal. As soon as we walked in, the staff immediately recognized the seriousness of the situation, dropped what they were doing, took my dog straight into triage, and provided him with the care he needed.

Thankfully, my dog is doing much better now. However, based on my experience today, I would absolutely not recommend this establishment to anyone, especially if you have a pet experiencing a medical emergency. In an emergency situation, you expect a veterinary clinic to show urgency, compassion, and a genuine concern for the animal in front of them. Unfortunately, that was not my experience here.

This one it was going to be the clinic of my dog for one year already, everything great until we started having attitud problems with one of the receptionist.
On one visit, my dog peed on the floor, she was a puppy and she peed a little, she showed attitude towards my wife, saying to the dog they have at the clinic: "I know it wasn't you, because you know where to go". My wife apologized for the inconvenient and say that she was going to clean up, she refused but still showed up attitude.

Today, I went into the clinic as a walk-in, (I know that you need appointment) but I went because my dog was peeing on a really brown color the night before and I couldn't make one, I got there with my dog and I said that I have an emergency( for me, was an emergency since my dog is family and I wanted to know what is wrong with her to act as fast as possible) she told me that the doctor was at surgery, and that they were totally booked for that they and that there were just openings for the next day. I completely understand, and I was never rude, she asked: "is your dog vomiting or faiting?" I said no, then she addd with mean tone, "So is not an emergency" then she said, "if you wanna go get that check there a pet clinic that close at six or if you want I can call emergency so they can drop everything that they're doing so they can attend you" all this was said on a really mean tone, not even looking at us to our faces or eyes, we were not being mean, we didn't deserve that treatment, so, I'm removing my dog from this clinic because I don't want to have any conversation or services with that lady.

I was not going to leave a review after things were settled but since I did not get a response back from Owner regarding if a treament was done.. here we go. I lived in the nearby building for years and always dreamt walking my puppy to the nearby vet. That dream came true when I bought a 10 week yorkie. Prior to picking up the yorkie, I used their text service to ask questions on shots and the person (in the philippines) answered some basic questions but they did not go into details. For instance, I was more concern about the shots  before taking the pup to work and they told me I would have to leave the puppy so it could be monitor. I was like okay, can I pick him up afterwards and they said yes by 530PM. When I arrived, I got more details on the spot. The monitoring is only 20 minutes and there were many miscommunications I wasn't told by their Upwork hired assistant in the philippines. Any ways, what REALLY anger me is they said pay upfront to book your slot and then the doctor will give you a treatment plan for pup. They don't tell you what you're paying for at all.

When I arrived and realized I wasn't getting what I requsted, I felt it was a scam. But now I understand the process when the Owner explained it to me. The ISSUE is that the owner thinks I am inexperienced pet owner, I am not. I allowed Nick to throw that gab. However, I am experienced to know an appointment doesn't take less than 15 minutes AND you don't blindly pay for an doctor appointment without knowing what you're getting seen or done. Literally, when I dropped dog off, walked to car and drove 2 minutes away, the doctor called me with results. It was definitely a money grab to me. They gave me my dog and no doctor spoke to me or nothing as promised.

my dog started to vimit 1 hour after seeing this vet. We are not allow in the exam room which is a red flag to me (It's not urgent care). He was very lethargic and was not eating (which i told vet) and now started throwing up. I asked Nick if anything was done because on the report everything was great and nothing was done, but in text Nick said it was dewormed. So I text to confirm which one was accurate the same day they refunded my money but no response from Nick (sign it all about money to them). I took my dog to the emergency room and my dog's blood sugar was so low it would have died that night. I just got the dog from the breeder on Sunday, visited the vet on Monday morning and they DID NOT tell me any of this!! They just wanted money to give me an expensive treatment plan which is probably their money maker.

$75 for a 15 minute appointment for piece of paper with false reports thatyou can't even advocate to Doctor but the front desk does it.

We appreciate the 5-star rating! Thank you for choosing Little Tokyo Pet Clinic for your baby's care. It is always a pleasure to help!

If there is ever anything more we can do for you, please don't hesitate to reach out at (213) 537-0989 or info@littletokyovet.com. We look forward to seeing you and your baby again soon!

Best,
Little Tokyo Pet Clinic

Thank you for reaching out to us. We noticed your 1-star rating and were genuinely concerned to see that you didn't have a great experience. Since there weren't any details shared in the review, we would really love the chance to hear more about what happened and see how we can make things right.

Please feel free to reach out to us at (213) 537-0989 or info@littletokyovet.com so we can chat and address your concerns directly. We hope to hear from you soon!

Best,
Little Tokyo Pet Clinic

10/10! I used to go to this vet for a few years while I lived close by - they were always kind and provided great service. fast forward a couple years and my pet insurance was denying my claim due to a “pre-existing condition”. Dr. Chung and Dr. Min were more than happy to look at my pups medical records and provided a strongly worded letter that eventually helped me overturn my claim and get refunded. If you need a vet, these guys will take care of you.

(I very rarely write reviews on businesses, as I am a writer for a big publication, so the fact that I’m doing this is indicative of how seriously I’m taking this matter.)

My cat was experiencing some unusual shedding at a spot where he was cut after a fight with his brother. I was concerned that the bald spot kept growing even after the wound had healed so I took him to the vet.

Vet took 15 mins to examine the bald spot, didn’t explain why it kept growing, didn’t even say what the cause might have been, even after my attempts to ask. (The vet ain’t vet-ing, it seems.) Just told me not to do anything, skin was healthy, sent us home.

Two nights later, clumps of hair went flying off him from a different area of his body.

I think that we could have used a more thorough examination or the vet actually taking the time to consider possible underlying causes instead of just looking at the affected area and essentially just saying, “oh it looks ok.”

Now I have to take more time off my busy week and stress my cat out again for another vet visit on top of me worrying that my baby boy has some sort of disease.

Very disappointed.

I recently had surgery here for a patella and ligament rupture, and the surgery went really well! I especially remember the kindness of the director and the staff.☺️ I think I will continue to come to this hospital exclusively.

The BEST pet clinic in LA! I’ve been a loyal for years, ever since I moved to LA.
Dr. Chung is such a wonderful, knowledgeable, and dedicated vet. The staff is always welcoming, responsive, and incredibly helpful. I especially love that they do non-anesthesia dental cleaning every month!

My 12yrs old cat gets regular check ups here and even had surgery last year and Dr. Chung provided truly top notch care throughout the entire process. It’s such a relief to have a clinic I can trust completely. Highly recommended!!!

I’ve been bring my pet here for a long time. I have always had a positive experience, from the front desk to the doctors, everyone is very friendly. They have always taken good care of my dog and they have always given me thorough explanations and don’t ask me for unnecessary procedures. Overall they are very helpful and kind, I wouldn’t take my baby anywhere else.

We have been coming to Little Tokyo Pet Clinic for over 10 years with our 2 fur babies. Dr. Chung and her team of experts deeply care about the pets that visit them. When my baby had IVDD and couldn’t walk- the team helped him walk again with proper treatment. And when it was time to let our other baby go, they were supportive both scientifically and spiritually. After we made the tough decision, our memorable last day with her wouldn’t have happened if it wasn’t for the team encouraging we could go enjoy one last special moment together before sending her to heaven. We took our baby to the beach and created memories that we will have forever. Our hearts are full because of Little Tokyo Pet Clinic and we are forever grateful for their care.
The little girl at the front desk is rude for no reason. She probably trying to push people away to harm the business or something because it’s not normal

I went with a serious emergency and very limited funds. Dr. J. along with her staff were amazing! Took care of baby and gave me information to get more affordable help. This place and the people working here, care for the well being of your babies! Thanks you so much Dr J!

Service was really nice and it was good that they could take us on short notice (cat fever)

Cons: they take your pet to the back and you cant see them treat her, they really hike up the prices on the tests, and arent very transparent with their recommendations. very much seems like they care about money more than your pet, sure it’s a business but the prices for tests are INSANE.  the treatment for fever was decently priced though. If you dont know what you want/need, or if it’s not urgent, do not go here.

Little Tokyo Pet Clinic doesn't know anything about cats. I recently moved to Downtown and I'm really far away from my primary vet. This vet charged me so much for each visit and tried to make me feel guilty for not accepting the unnecessary treatments they suggested.The staff has a bad attitude and doctor c is ridiculously out of line, rude, and unprofessional. My baby has kidney disease and she also had a UTI. She told me I needed to stop giving her the kidney diet I am feeding her and just give her a UTI prescription they sold there ( that is high in phosphorus and horrible for cats with kidney disease). I thought that seems very dangerous so I talked to my primary vet and they told me not to do that by any means. They told me that she needs to be on her kidney diet for the rest of her life. They also told me that I could treat a UTI and her Kidney disease at the same time. Cats with kidney disease are more prone to getting UTIs. I found her food to treat her UTI that was low in phosphorus and treats that would help her kidneys and UTI (it also prevents UTIs). I mixed her kidney diet with the UTI prescription I bought. Doctor c also wanted me to do a third round of antibiotics and told me my baby wouldn't fully get rid of her UTI and in three weeks she would still have it. I declined after talking to my primary vet about it because antibiotics are horrible for cats who have Kindney disease. If they need it and it's absolutely necessary then it's fine but she wanted to give my cat another round without even checking her urine! She was so rude about it and tried to make me feel guilty for not wanting to do the shot!! When I went in today they did a urinalysis test and she didn't have a UTI anymore but they still wanted to give her another antibiotic shot! She said her red blood cells were high and that she could get a UTI again. I told her my baby's red blood cell count is high because she has Kidney Disease and cats with kidney disease are more prone to getting UTIs because they have a high red blood cell count. I also told her that antibiotic shots are bad for cats with kidney disease and then she asked me why I care so much about her kidney disease. My jaw was on the floor!!!!!She shook her head and started arguing with me. Please don't take your cat here. She doesn't know anything about cats or cares!!! They are only trying to get money from you! They use your love for your pet as a tool for them to get money. They up charged me for everything and the 4 times I went in they always charged me different prices for the same tests I would get previously there. The Dr also uses AI to diagnosis! Run away from this place if you care about your pet!!!!!!!

For 2 years, my cats have been going to Little Tokyo Pet Clinic. It's expensive, but I honestly do not care. As long as my pets are getting the best care, I would pay anything.

In hindsight, I don't think Dr. Hyun knows much about cat healthcare. No exams are ever done in front of you, and your pets are taken to the back. I am pretty sure, my cat has never gotten a thorough physical exam here. I recently went to another vet who did an exam in front of me and learned way more about my cat's condition. Perhaps, Dr. Hyun is a better vet for other pets, just not cats?

Although I don't care about the price, every time I would reject a service/procedure, they would passively text me "It's just one test." I don't think they meant to be passive, but it comes off that way. It really hurt me and made me feel like a bad mom. :(

I really trusted everything Dr. Hyun and the staff said. They are supposed to be the experts after all. I am just very hurt by all this. I love the staff. They are all so nice and polite. Dr. Hyun is also very nice and kind. Everyone is great. I just don't think my cat received the ideal care here.

I want to make it clear that I don't think they would ever harm your animals. They are super responsive over texts, and that is absolutely amazing. This is why I do not have the heart to give a 1 star. They are doing everything else right. Customer service is great! I just don't think they are knowledgable on cat healthcare. Perhaps, it's different for dogs or other pets.

The reason my review is a 2 star is because I won't come here again. Although the staff is nice, I do believe that is a bare minimum for any business. My rating is solely based on their healthcare knowledge and expertise.

Edit: Review is 1 star now. Got an email from the owner basically not taking any responsibility for their faults. Would've preferred no response than that.

Little Tokyo Pet Clinic is the best! I have been going here with my dog Moose since I’ve rescued him (2021). He’s had hip surgery with Dr. Chung and recovered beautifully. He also has allergy issues and I really appreciated how Dr. Chung explained all the options for me clearly. Moose now is very happy with the allergy treatment we agreed on and doing great! They have never pressured me into paying for an expensive test or been pushy about his care. I really like how they lay out all the options and understand that pet care is expensive and will work with you on giving your pet the best care within your budget. Please give them a try! You won’t regret it.

Here are a few photos of Moose happily recovering from hip surgery

If anyone who is suffering because you don’t know what to do with your dearest fur baby’s health, I think this clinic could be your next step. I have been with my fur babies since 2013 but I never met dr like Dr. Chung before. I started to come to this clinic since 2022.

She explains thoroughly in every details about my babies health and explains options so it is much easier to make best choices for my babies. Staff are nice and parking is convenient.

I hope this review can help someone who is looking for answers.

Exceptional Care and Compassion at Little Tokyo Pet Clinic

When I lived downtown, I brought my English bulldog, Rufus, to Little Tokyo Pet Clinic for an infection. After just one visit, he not only left with treatment for the infection, but the doctor also noticed—on her own—his chronic dry eye issue and offered a solution. Rufus had suffered from this for years, and despite visits to multiple vets (even specialists), no one could resolve it beyond temporary fixes. But this doctor prescribed Tocralimus medication, which was nothing short of a miracle—it almost immediately improved his dry eye. What truly touched me was that she addressed this issue unprompted, even though I hadn’t brought him in for it.

Though we recently had to say goodbye to Rufus, I will forever be grateful to Little Tokyo Pet Clinic for making his last years far more comfortable than they would have been without that treatment.

Beyond their outstanding medical care, the clinic itself is a joy to visit. It’s extremely clean, beautifully decorated, and welcoming. The staff is friendly, attentive, and always goes above and beyond. The doctors are amazing—they communicate clearly (even via text, which is so convenient!) and promptly respond to prescription requests from third parties like Chewy.

I cannot recommend Little Tokyo Pet Clinic highly enough. Whether for routine care or more serious concerns, they provide exceptional service with genuine compassion. Any pet parent would be lucky to have them as their vet.

I can't say enough good things about Little Tokyo Pet Clinic and my experience there. The hospital is a very clean and modern facility. The staff are super friendly, helpful and responsive. The entire team took very good care of my senior (14 yo) mini schnauzer. My fur baby was having some GI issues and wasn't eating and having some other issues so I took him to LTPC to get checked out. They did a thorough check and workup on him and performed X-rays and other diagnostic testing onsite with results and clear imaging emailed to me while I waited. Dr. C explained everything, including test results very clearly and I left feeling like I had a good game plan going forward regarding my baby's care. This clinic is the best and would highly recommend them.

We have been going to Little Tokyo for many years and have been with them for two dogs now. They always take excellent care of us and all our questions for our pups. Truly goes above and beyond for their furry patients!

Little Tokyo Clinic is my favorite, trusted pet clinic. The vets are outstanding, so knowledgeable and skilled, and they go out of their way to explain everything and help your pets get the care they need. And they can do everything, from routine care, to travel documents, to surgery under anesthesia. They are really a treasure, and I wouldn’t go anywhere else—I can trust they are the top level of healthcare for everything when it comes to my dogs.

Little Tokyo pet clinic is the best! They always help us with anything we need for our little maltipoo and they always respond to your texts when we have any questions. The staff and doctors are all really nice and accommodating with anything you need. We take our dog to Hawaii too and they help you with your rabies tests and health certificate!

I received assistance from this doctor when I was returning to Japan. The doctor speaks both Japanese and English. The staff are highly professional, even by American standards, and provide meticulous work and follow-up without any mistakes. Since the doctor graduated from a Japanese university, I had my elderly dog ​​neutered here. They provided thorough pre-operative explanations and examinations, as well as smooth post-operative follow-up care. They also helped with the export documents, allowing me to return to Japan safely. If you need export documents to Japan, I highly recommend this hospital because they have experience with this type of procedure. Thank you, Dr. Cheng

We can't thank Little Tokyo Pet Clinic enough — they truly saved the day for us.

While on a road trip, we rescued a lost puppy and decided to adopt her. After getting her fully vaccinated and microchipped, we needed a health certificate so she could fly home with us. Unfortunately, another vet gave us an incomplete certificate and incorrect information, leaving us scrambling late on a Friday night to find help.

After a long, stressful search through the weekend — calling clinic after clinic with no luck — we found Little Tokyo Pet Clinic. They were incredibly kind, responsive, and knowledgeable. They understood our situation immediately and went out of their way to help us.

Thanks to Dr. Hye-Ok Chung and her team, we were able to get everything sorted and continue our journey with peace of mind. Their compassion, professionalism, and willingness to help in a time of real need meant the world to us.

Highly recommend this clinic to anyone — especially if you’re looking for a team that genuinely cares. 💛🐾

Absolutely happy with this hospital, I was able to quickly get an appointment and their communication through text is so quick and helps deliver info to them before I even arrive. The moment I saw her getting stomach issues, I instantly thought of this place and the care provided during my first visit, didn’t hesitate to go back! The info for post-visit care is thorough and emailed to you, which is another amazing plus. Absolutely recommend this place! They also have 90 min parking validation in the parking lot next to the hospital.
All the staff are kind. My dog ​​has recovered.

Overpriced, borderline predatory. The quote for treating a hotspot on my dog was about 900$, when the treatment for a hotspot can be found on Amazon for like 50$. I did receive some useful information, but believe the cost I was quoted was excessive

This place is run by greedy and money hungry people unfortunately. If you dog has something that could be common like an upset stomach/vomiting, they'll go over ALL possible reasons from benign like allergies to kidney failure to cancer. They'll recommend 6 tests to test all and quote you $950.

Vs a normal vet will say there are other symptoms to consider to see if it's necessary to do all these tests at once. Maybe try out something most common, and see if that fixes it and let us know in a few days. If there are other alarming symptoms, I could understand being so extreme, but right now it's just coughing.

I will never go here again. Every single time I can feel the vet trying to cause alarm. He even cited my dog lost a lot of weight from the last time my dog came in 7 months ago (how can you know if it's a lot recently or slowly since last year because we've been trying to get her to be more healthy).

Both the woman and the man vet do this exploitative practice to make you anxious and do all tests. It's sad to come across people like this. They don't care for you or your pet. They just want to up charge as much as possible.

Dr. Chung is a very warm-hearted, bright-aura, confident and reliable female doctor. I don't like lazy doctors, but she is quick to deal with problems and make decisions. She speaks English, Japanese and Korean fluently, which really helped me out when I was panicking at other hospitals. The room temperature was just right. My baby was wrapped in warm cloths and pillows and was able to be hospitalized in a very good environment. There are many cold places in the hospital, like a refrigerator, and my cat gets cold easily, so I was very relieved. I met the receptionist and other doctors, and everyone was kind. I will continue to come here.Thank you so much.

I use to enjoy this vet a lot. They had a fast response time versus other vets. And at the time were the nearest vet to me so it was convenient. When I switched my cat to another diet that better suited him instead of their vet prescribed …

Staff is very attentive and professional. They communicate mainly via texts and have THE fastest reponse time of any business I know. Appointments are very easy to get. They answer all questions posed. The vet, Dr." H" is pleasant and …
The best vet in town! So communicative even after hours. So thorough. Lucy and Benito say thank you!
